description:
Why Do We Sweat? Your Built-In Air Conditioner! — You race around the soccer field, and tiny droplets of water roll down your forehead! Why does your skin start leaking water?
Kids science answer for "why do we sweat kids science cartoon" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

When you sprint and heat up, 3 million sweat glands release water droplets; as the breeze evaporates the liquid, it steals heat away to cool you down.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
